# AdversarialRobustness

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The ability of AI systems to maintain correct operation under deliberate input perturbations or deceptive tactics designed to cause failure. Critical for TCC/iNEST in military settings where sensor data can be spoofed, requiring topology-aware defenses in distributed neuromorphic networks.
